description: Discover backlink-profile competitors and prioritize overlap, authority, and link-gap research actions. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

exclude_large_domains.description: Exclude very large general-purpose domains from competitor recommendations when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

limit.description: Maximum number of backlink competitor records to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 25.

main_domain.description: Compare competitor backlinks at the main-domain level when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

min_intersections.description: Minimum count of shared referring domains required for a backlink competitor. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 10000000. Optional; no client default.

min_rank.description: Minimum provider backlink authority score, not a Google search position; use the supported score scale and stated input bounds. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 1000. Optional; no client default.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset measured in rows; use with limit for pagination. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 20000. Default: 0.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "rank", "intersections", "opportunity". Default: "opportunity".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_backlinks_competitors
title: AgentSEO Backlinks Competitors
